title: Clique-dependent strongly sublinear treewidth and strongly sublinear tree-independence number
summary: We establish a strongly sublinear counterpart of a recent result of Chudnovsky, E S, and Lokshtanov (arXiv 2025) on treewidth and tree-independence number. Namely, we prove that a hereditary graph class has strongly sublinear tree-independence number if and only if, for every fixed clique bound, its graphs of bounded clique number have strongly sublinear treewidth. In fact, this is part of a broader equivalence theorem.
